feeds.title: Education Week » Bilingual Education
feeds.description: At Education Week, we believe that all children deserve a high-quality education. Guided by this vision, we aim to empower the entire education community, from educators and policymakers to business leaders and beyond. In our Bilingual Education blog get educational news, analysis, and opinion about the education model where students are taught part of the day in their first language and the rest of the day in a new language, typically English.

feeds.title: Bilingual Monkeys Blog
feeds.description: Bilingual Monkey is a lively worldwide community where parents can share their bilingual experiences and lend mutual support. The aim is to provide practical ideas and inspiration to help meet this challenge of bilingualism with greater success. Bilingual Monkeys is a blog that provides ideas and inspiration on raising bilingual kids, information on bilingualism in children, and resources to promote bilingual development. It offers strategies and support for busy parents seeking to raise children with abilities in more than one language.

feeds.title: Language Lizard Blog
feeds.description: Language Lizard has been helping educators teach dual language learners and building multicultural classrooms for years. We want this blog to to be an essential resource for you - educators, librarians, and families - who are trying to teach children about language and culture.

feeds.title: Spanish Mama Blog
feeds.description: Resources for Teaching Language & Spanglish Living. Spanish Mama offers ideas and help for the language classroom and Spanglish families. I'm Elisabeth, the teacher and mother behind Spanish Mama. I actually never expected to speak Spanish, teach Spanish, or raise my kids in it. I created this little corner of the internet because life surprised me. I did learn a second language, and later, I discovered resources that gave me confidence as a teacher and parent.

feeds.title: BookLingual Blog
feeds.description: BookLingual offers kids Spanish dual-language storybooks. With BookLingual learning programs and books, your kids can learn. We offer programs for English and Spanish learners. We work with elementary schools, libraries, and parents for rapid dual-language Spanish learning.

feeds.title: Bilingual Nest Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about the benefits of early childhood bilingual education here. We've curated informative articles for future references. Bilingual Nest is a French and/or Spanish bilingual preschool and daycare in West Harlem, New York that welcomes students Three months to five years old. Each year, we adapt our teaching according to the group of students, their ages, and needs.

feeds.title: My Bilingual Life Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Twila and here at My Bilingual Life, we want to help you (or your students) become bilingual by providing educational resources in English and Spanish for Bilingual and ESL teachers.
